title: Grado III: Integral impropia, Escudo de bits, Combustión, Virus atómico y Reinicio
description: docs/animas/matemagico/README.md and docs/animas/tecnopata/README.md § Grade III, docs/animas/README.md § Combustión. In the fight tester against three sturdy dogs, one player leading both. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 600; }); s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = Math.round(a.maxHp * .55); }); });

steps.caption: Matemágico with grade III: Integral impropia in the Cálculo line
Integral impropia: ∫ from 0 to ∞ drawn in his circle, laid between the party, green light jetting from each end into both; both get PV back and Sanación
Escudo de bits: Bip throws its bits up over the party and they close as a dome of cyan light; the dogs' blows land on its shell, dent it and glint, and it stops each whole
The wall in front of the party, and its PV on their plates

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes[0].timed = { ...s.foes[0].timed, quemado: { level: 3, left: 10, next: 2 } }; s.foes.slice(1).forEach(f => { f.timed = { ...f.timed, quemado: { level: 2, left: 10, next: 2 } }; }); })

steps.caption: Foc Binari on a dog at Quemado III: with Combustión the fire climbs to IV and burns white, sparks gone blue-white, a heartbeat of heat throwing embers off it
Combustión on the first dog: the white fire, and its own icon on the plate
Bip rams the dog in Combustión: the fire pulls in, then bursts; a ring of flame along the floor, embers to the other two, whose fires go up a level. PASIVA · Combustión over Gerard
Virus atómico: a swarm of tiny Bips weaves from Bip into the first dog and closes round it; it keeps buzzing round its body
Foc Binari on the infected dog: the fire lands on it, and a stream of tiny Bips carries it to the other two. ¡Contagio! Quemado on all three
Reinicio: a wave of nanites leaves Bip along the floor; over each dog a dial turns backwards and a scan climbs it: every clock is full again
